title: Multi-Station Painting Studio
description: One static multi-station painting studio under the original painting studio scene program. A complete fixed-tilt drafting desk occupies the left foreground, a whole fixed H-frame easel and blank board the rear work position, a full six-tray perforated drying rack the right rear, and a whole empty two-basin tool trolley the right foreground. A clear central approach separates drawing, vertical painting, drying and mobile-tool-storage positions within a two-wall open cutaway. Four complete published unit-scale unrotated props retain every component and original PBR. Only the closed floor and two closed partial room walls are scene-only. One scene, zero new independent models. This differs from the old single easel-and-palette small display pad through its multi-position studio work/storage layout, not by changing easel angle, paint colours or frame size. Empty board, trays and basins remain empty; no artworks, paint, brushes, paper, people, animated folding, wheels, tool compatibility, load, ergonomics, drying performance, accessibility or safety certification is claimed.
